results.name: Gut Wound
results.text: Halve the fighter's Life value (rounding up).

results.name: Blinded In One Eye
results.text: The fighter's Bow value is reduced by 1.

results.name: Fractured Arm
results.text: The fighter's Blade value is reduced by 1.

results.name: Broken Leg
results.text: Halve the fighter's Move value (rounding up).

results.name: Head Injury
results.text: Halve the fighter's Initiative value (rounding up).

results.name: Frayed Nerves
results.text: Halve the fighter's Willpower value (rounding up).

results.name: Chronic Black Rot
results.text: The fighter gains 2 levels of Black Rot.

results.name: Black Rot
results.text: The fighter gains 1 level of Black Rot.

results.name: Full Recovery
results.text: The fighter is found by their allies unconscious with only minor injuries. They make a full recovery.

results.name: Heroic Escape
results.text: The fighter makes a full recovery. In addition, they earn 10 bonus experience in Step Three of the aftermath.

results.name: Full Recovery
results.text: The fighter makes a full recovery.

results.name: Laid to Rest
results.text: The undead creature is undone. Treat this result as killed.

results.name: Full Recovery
results.text: The fighter suffers no lasting effects. Treat this result as full recovery.

results.name: Banished
results.text: The demon is banished from the mortal world for 666 years. Treat this result as killed.

results.name: Fractured Essence
results.text: The demon's grip on its corporeal form is momentarily unravelled. The demon misses the next battle.

results.name: Unharmed
results.text: Mortal weapons are not enough to deal lasting harm to a creature such as this. Treat this result as full recovery.

recover.label: Recuperate
recover.note: Roll a dice for each temporary injury a fighter had before this battle: on a 5–6 it is removed.
